HOW TO PLAY

MoveForward and back walk. Double-tap forward to sprint, then hit Punch or Kick for a rush attack.
BlockHold back when an enemy is close and you guard. Hold back + down (the ↙ corner) to crouch block. Low sweeps beat a standing block.
CombosPunch ×3 = jab, cross, uppercut. Kick ×3 = kick, roundhouse, flurry finisher. Mix them. Repeating one move over and over weakens it.
CrouchWhile ducking: Punch = uppercut, Kick = sweep, Strike and Special still work.
StrikeA slow, heavy hit with a short cooldown. When your orange meter is half full it turns into SPECIAL.
Keys P1A/D move · W jump · S crouch · F punch · G kick · T strike/special · H block
TouchArcade view: left thumb anywhere = joystick (push all the way sideways to sprint, down-back = crouch block). Right thumb: Punch, Kick, Strike, Block, Jump. Game Boy view: D-pad moves, A = punch, B = kick, A+B together = strike/special, SELECT = block, START = pause.
ControllerStick or D-pad moves · X/□ punch · A/✕ kick · Y/△ strike/special · B/○ or triggers block · LB sprint · START pause. Menus: D-pad + A.
MatchBest of 3 rounds. Arcade: beat every other fighter; the last fight is in the final arena. The CPU learns your habits on every level and gets sharper as you get better.
